name: Breath of the Pasture
detailed_description:
A heartfelt life-sim about love, land, and the magic of the countryside.

Beneath the laughter of a bustling town and the warmth of its kindhearted residents, an old, long-abandoned ranch quietly awaits a new owner. And when you one day ride across the meadows with your friends and pets, may you still remember the simple joy of cuddling a puppy or galloping through the fields on horseback.

Compose your very own pastoral symphony—
Listen to the rain as it falls. Chase the breeze on sunny days. Watch crops reach for the sky. Let your cows and sheep rest in peace. Fall in love. Grow a farm. That is the Breath of the Pasture.

We're so happy you’ve found your way here. If you’re a fan of games like story of the seasons or Stardew Valley, please—don’t miss this. Trust us: we made this for you. And we promise, you won’t be disappointed.

🌾 Welcome to the world of Breath of the Pasture!

Here, you can do anything you dream of:

🚜 Farming at scale

Start with 1,350 plots of arable land—vast and full of potential. This is a true farming haven!

🌱 Seasonal changes

The game includes three rich seasons—spring, summer, and autumn—each with exclusive wild forage and seasonal crops. (Winter was too tough to finish, sorry! 😅)

🥕 Crops

Grow 24 different crops, each with distinct stages and visuals. But be careful—crops only grow in specific seasons!

🧚‍♀️ Helpers: Spirits & Robots

Call upon cheerful spirits to water and harvest, or deploy trusty robots for planting and care. (We really hope you’ll love them as much as we do!)

🐾 Animals

Raise pets like dogs and horses, or farm animals like cows, sheep, and chickens. You can even adopt wild animals like foxes or bunnies!

🎣 Fishing & Bug Catching

Catch nearly 200 species of fish and aquatic life, plus 50+ unique butterflies! Each species comes with an ecological background—learn where and how to find them through natural clues.

🍳 Cooking System

Experiment freely with ingredients and cookware. The game features over 600 dishes to discover and create!

⛏️ Mines & Treasures

Dig up ores and precious gems! Use your hoe to excavate and hammer to smash rocks. Wealth lies beneath!

💞 Romance & Marriage

Over 10 romance candidates, with inclusive gender options for all players. Every townsperson also has unique friendship storylines.
(P.S. Reverse proposals are coming! We're working hard on it!)

🎁 Gifts & Birthdays

Everyone has their favorite things. Build friendships, and villagers will even celebrate your birthday!

👥 Local Multiplayer

We’re working toward split-screen two-player mode—pending tech success, it’s coming!

👒 Fashion & Riding Gear

Due to limited production, we’re focusing on hats and rideable mounts. But dozens of options await, including DIY hat design tools for your personal touch!

🏡 Decorating

Customize your farm and town with dozens of decorations. Make your world truly yours.

🌐 Online Co-op

Up to 4 players can play together! Help each other water, harvest, and grow together.

📺 Community Sharing

Being a beginner is tough. Our Time Gift system allows players to receive gifts from others through the in-game TV! Someday, you might send your own kindness to someone else too.

And there’s still so much more waiting for you to discover—
Let the land surprise you.

💬 A few heartfelt words...

We wish we could have made even more. The Steam version will be a unique build, with HD textures, official mod support, and even a DIY story editor. So many dreams we want to realize—we’ll do our best to finish them by mid-2026.

Thank you to every single player who supports us. You’re the reason this game exists.
Thank you to our amazing developer team—you made magic.
And lastly... thank you to our investors. 

Please, above all—
Be happy.
We hope this game brings you joy.

                                                                                — From the developer of Breath of the Pasture
